name: youtube-editor
description: Frame-accurate YouTube video editing agent with proof. The cs-youtube-video-editor agent makes the editorial calls (dead air, filler words, retakes, must-keep beats) and six stdlib tools on top of ffmpeg do the work to the exact frame and audio sample: media_analyzer.py probes rational frame rates, VFR, interlacing and A/V offsets, measures silence/black/scenes/EBU R128 loudness, and proposes a padded, word-safe cut list; edit_planner.py compiles an EDL (seconds, timecode, SMPTE incl. drop-frame, or frame numbers) into a plan where every cut is snapped to a real frame, no cut lands inside a spoken word, transitions shorten the timeline by exactly their overlap, and audio boundaries derive from the output frame timeline; effects_library.py adds 50+ transitions (crossfade, dip to black, wipes, slides) and effects (zoom punch-ins, text, blur, color/LUT, burned-in captions, voice-ducked music, fades) gated by frame number; render_engine.py renders by frame and sample index (never keyframe-snapping stream copy) with sample-exact audio crossfades and true-peak-checked loudness to -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP in YouTube's recommended H.264/AAC/faststart format, plus Shorts; edit_verifier.py refuses to call an edit done until frame count, per-cut frames, per-piece audio alignment (1 ms), transition blends, effect on/off edge frames, burned captions, loudness and upload spec all pass, with four negative controls; timeline_remapper.py carries chapters and captions through the edit. No uploads, no API keys, never touches the source file.
